passage.text: Lucky, a three-year-old dog from Hua Hin, is home again after a long journey.
passage.reading: ˈlʌki, ə ˈθriː ˈjɪr ˈoʊld ˈdɔːɡ frəm ˈhuːə ˈhɪn, ɪz ˈhoʊm əˈɡɛn ˈæftər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈdʒɜːrni.

passage.text: Last month, he got lost during a family trip to Bangkok.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, hiː ˈɡɑːt ˈlɔːst ˈdʊrɪŋ ə ˈfæməli ˈtrɪp tə ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: His owners looked for him for three days, but they could not find him.
passage.reading: hɪz ˈoʊnərz ˈlʊkt fər hɪm fər ˈθriː ˈdeɪz, bʌt ðeɪ kʊd ˈnɑːt ˈfaɪnd hɪm.

passage.text: Sadly, they went home without him.
passage.reading: ˈsædli, ðeɪ ˈwɛnt ˈhoʊm wɪˈðaʊt hɪm.

passage.text: Then, last Sunday morning, the family heard a noise at the door.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn, ˈlæst ˈsʌndeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ðə ˈfæməli ˈhɜːrd ə ˈnɔɪz ət ðə ˈdɔːr.

passage.text: When they opened it, Lucky was there.
passage.reading: wɛn ðeɪ ˈoʊpənd ɪt, ˈlʌki wʌz ˈðɛr.

passage.text: He was dirty, thin and very tired, but he was very happy to see them.
passage.reading: hiː wʌz ˈdɜːrti, ˈθɪn ənd ˈvɛri ˈtaɪərd, bʌt hiː wʌz ˈvɛri ˈhæpi tə ˈsiː ðɛm.

passage.text: Lucky walked about 200 kilometers from Bangkok to Hua Hin.
passage.reading: ˈlʌki ˈwɔːkt əˈbaʊt ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd kɪˈlɑːmətərz frəm ˈbæŋkɑːk tə ˈhuːə ˈhɪn.

passage.text: The journey took him about three weeks.
passage.reading: ðə ˈdʒɜːrni ˈtʊk hɪm əˈbaʊt ˈθriː ˈwiːks.

passage.text: "It's a miracle," said his owner, Mrs. Somsri.
passage.reading: ɪts ə ˈmɪrəkəl, ˈsɛd hɪz ˈoʊnər, ˈmɪsɪz ˈsɑːmsriː.

passage.text: She said that her children cried every night when Lucky was lost.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈsɛd ðæt hɜːr ˈtʃɪldrən ˈkraɪd ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt wɛn ˈlʌki wʌz ˈlɔːst.

passage.text: The family offered a reward of 10,000 baht, but Lucky found his own way home.
passage.reading: ðə ˈfæməli ˈɔːfərd ə rɪˈwɔːrd əv ˈtɛn ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt, bʌt ˈlʌki ˈfaʊnd hɪz ˈoʊn ˈweɪ ˈhoʊm.

passage.text: Now they want to give the money to an animal hospital.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ ðeɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈɡɪv ðə ˈmʌni tu ən ˈænɪməl ˈhɑːspɪtəl.

passage.text: A vet said that Lucky was healthy, but he needed a lot of food and sleep.
passage.reading: ə ˈvɛt ˈsɛd ðæt ˈlʌki wʌz ˈhɛlθi, bʌt hiː ˈniːdɪd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfuːd ənd ˈsliːp.

passage.text: "He's eating and sleeping all day," Mrs. Somsri said and laughed.
passage.reading: hiːz ˈiːtɪŋ ənd ˈsliːpɪŋ ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ, ˈmɪsɪz ˈsɑːmsriː ˈsɛd ənd ˈlæft.
